{{#Widget:style|style=table.CustomModule>tbody>tr:nth-child(odd) {background-color:#EBECEE;}
table.CustomModule>tbody>tr:nth-child(even) { background-color:#FAFAFA;}
table.ModuleData>tbody>tr:nth-child(3n-2) { background-color:#FAFAFA;}
table.ModuleData>tbody>tr:nth-child(3n-1) { background-color:#F2F2F3;}
table.ModuleData>tbody>tr:nth-child(3n) { background-color:#EBECEE;}
.modtable { min-width:800px;max-width:1000px;table-layout:fixed;}
.modpic { min-width:85px;width:10%}
.modopttype { width:10%}
.modline { width:100%;margin:0px;display:table;table-layout:fixed;}
.linec { text-align:center}
.iconst { width:12.5%}
.stats { min-width:80px}
.talent { width:75%}
.typeback { background-color:#2F2F2F}

/* theme:begin hover-keep 行悬停时保住单元格底色（皮肤的悬停底色特异性更高），见 prts-skin-migration/docs/主题适配盘点.md */
.wikitable > tbody > tr:hover > .typeback {
  background-color:#2F2F2F;
}
/* theme:end hover-keep */
}}
